statement: A corporation formed outside Washington registers to do business in the state by filing a Foreign Registration Statement with the Secretary of State ($180 filing fee online, plus an online processing fee), attaching a certificate of existence or good standing from the home jurisdiction issued no more than 60 days before submission, and supplying registered-agent and principal-office details including the email addresses WAC 434-112-045(4) requires.
caveat: Whether an out-of-state business is 'doing business' in Washington is not decided by the Secretary of State; RCW 23.95.520 lists activities that do not constitute doing business. Registration with the Secretary of State is separate from the Department of Revenue business license and tax obligations. Verify fees on the live instructions page before filing.
